text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems a festival is being held nearby today. Since Kitasan Black loves festivals so much, she invites me to check it out with her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wooow! I just love the atmosphere at festivals! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yakisoba, okonomiyaki, grilled squid! I wanna try everything!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hmm… O-okay, but if I volunteer to carry the portable shrine, I'll be able to work up a good sweat and burn it all off! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Now that I have a plan, let's go, Trainer! ♪
choice_data_list: If you overeat, even carrying the portable shrine won't burn it all off.
Yup, eat to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-you think so? Yeah, you're right…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Then, uh, I'll try to eat in moderation!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's super fun going around all the food stalls and finding stuff I wanna eat! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look! Those grilled carrots look delish!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The aroma, texture, and shape are all perfect! I'll take one, please! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Time to eaaat!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch, munch…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch… Gulp…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black silently eats her way through the grilled carrot without answering my question.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Mmm! That was suuuper tasty!
choice_data_list: You were so focused on your food.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, did you say something to me while I was eating?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! I didn't hear you at all! When I eat carrots, I go into a trance of sorts…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I just get so into savoring the depth and sweetness of the carrot… Ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sight of Kitasan Black apologizing sheepishly is quite a heartwarming one.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aw yeah! Time to let loose and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, sir! Can I have one cotton candy, please?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey! Why don't we split an order of takoyaki?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The grilled corn looks good, too! ♪ I'm gonna grab one!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… That was all so delicious! ♪ What should we sample next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't help but worry about Kitasan Black… She's eating so much that even carrying a portable shrine might not burn it all off.
